# VIP Nails & Spa

> Nail salon & spa based in Austin, Texas. VIP Nails & Spa in Anderson Mill is where Tina recreates any design you bring, from hand-painted strawberries to cat eye and clean white French sets, plus hot stone pedicures.

- Phone: (512) 547-5596
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander
- Yelp rating: 4.3 from 176 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/vip-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/vip-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
VIP Nails & Spa is next to the H-E-B on North 183 in Anderson Mill. Tina, Hannah and the team do acrylic and gel sets, hand-painted art, cat eye and French, and hot stone pedicures. Clients call it super clean, cozy and quick, open for last-minute Sunday manis, and they come back for Tina, who re-creates every picture they throw at her.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at VIP Nails & Spa?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 547-5596 or book online.
- Q: Where is VIP Nails & Spa?
  A: 14028 N US 183, Bldg A, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about VIP?
  A: VIP Nails & Spa is rated 4.3 stars from 176 Yelp reviews. Clients mention Tina's hand-painted art, a super clean salon and quick, friendly service.
